title: Dynamic Median with Queries
statement:
Process a sequence of queries on a dynamic multiset:
- "A x" — add integer x to the multiset.
- "M" — print the current median.

The median rules:
- If the count is odd, the median is the middle value.
- If the count is even, the median is the average of the two middle values. Print as X.5 if not a whole number.

You must use two heaps (max-heap for lower half, min-heap for upper half) to answer each M query in O(log N).
inputFormat:
The first line contains Q (total queries).
The next Q lines are either "A x" or "M".
outputFormat: For each M query, print the current median on its own line.
constraints:
1 <= Q <= 2*10^4
-10^6 <= x <= 10^6
At least one A query appears before any M query.
The multiset is never empty when M is called.

7
A 5
A 15
M
A 1

M
